_comment: Expansion 3 part D.3: level 7 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Spells that wait for Part E or F are not here.

conjure_celestial.name: Conjure Celestial

again.name: Conjure Celestial: the pillar moves
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action sends the pillar of light to a new spot; whoever it falls on is bathed in it.

conjure_celestial.text: A pillar of light, 10 feet across, stands within 90 feet (concentration, ten minutes). Your friends in it, or who step in, are healed 4d12 plus your casting modifier; foes make a Dexterity save or take 6d12 radiant, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d12 to both. A bonus action moves it.

delayed_blast_fireball.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
delayed_blast_fireball.text: A glowing bead of fire is flung up to 150 feet and bursts at once in a 20-foot sphere: everyone in it, friend or foe, makes a Dexterity save or takes 12d6 fire, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d6. Dry things there catch fire.

divine_word.name: Divine Word
divine_word.text: A bonus action: you utter a word of power and each foe within 30 feet makes a Charisma save. A failure with 50 hit points or fewer: at 20 it dies; 21-30 blind, deaf and stunned; 31-40 blind and deaf; 41-50 deaf. Celestials, elementals, fey and fiends that fail are sent from this plane for good.

finger_of_death.name: Finger of Death
finger_of_death.text: You unleash negative energy at a creature within 60 feet: a Constitution save or 7d8 plus 30 necrotic damage, half as much on a save. A humanoid it kills rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie that follows your orders, and goes on serving you after the fight.

fire_storm.name: Fire Storm
fire_storm.text: A storm of fire rages in a 30-foot block up to 150 feet away: your foes in it make a Dexterity save or take 7d10 fire, half on a save. Your friends are spared. Dry things there catch fire.

forcecage.name: Forcecage

material.text: ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes

forcecage.text: A solid, invisible box of force, 10 feet on a side, closes round a place within 100 feet (concentration, an hour): everyone inside is sealed away from the fight, and nothing passes in or out. Dispel Magic cannot end it. It consumes ruby dust worth 1,500 gold.

mordenkainens_sword.name: Mordenkainen's Sword
mordenkainens_sword.text: A spectral sword appears within 90 feet (concentration, a minute) and strikes at once: a melee spell attack for 4d12 force plus your casting modifier. On later turns a bonus action moves it 30 feet and strikes again.

power_word_fortify.name: Power Word Fortify
power_word_fortify.text: A word of power over up to six friends within 60 feet: 120 temporary hit points shared out evenly among them, those nearest the foe first.

prismatic_spray.name: Prismatic Spray
prismatic_spray.text: Rays of light fan out in a 60-foot cone. Each creature caught makes a Dexterity save against a ray picked by a die: 12d6 fire, acid, lightning, poison or cold (half on a save); indigo slowly turns it to stone; violet blinds it and may cast it from this plane; or two rays.

reverse_gravity.name: Reverse Gravity
reverse_gravity.text: Gravity turns over in a 50-foot-radius column up to 100 feet away (concentration, a minute): each creature there makes a Dexterity save or falls upward and hangs in the sky, striking a ceiling if there is one. When the spell ends, they fall.
